name: Dining Deck
detailed_description:
Dining Deck is a turn-based cooperative deckbuilder where players must work together to run a restaurant, balancing the chaos of the kitchen and the needs of demanding customers. Synchronize your decks, manage service encounters, and tackle unpredictable challenges as you strive to serve every meal on time

Full Release Features

🔥 Real-Time Co-op Deckbuilding – Work together in perfect harmony! Synchronize your builds, balance the restaurant, and adapt to the chaos as you and your partner manage the kitchen and floor in real time.

📜 Dynamic Deck Construction – Choose from 300+ unique cards to craft the perfect strategy. Discover powerful team cards to assist your partner and keep the service running smoothly.

🍳 Manage your restaurant with Appliances – Unlock and choose from 50+ appliances, from high-tech grills to magic-infused dishwashers, to enhance your restaurant’s efficiency.

👥 Face Unique Service Encounters – Adapt to different service challenges ranging from demanding VIP customers to food critics who hold your fate in their hands.

🔺 Ascension Levels – Increase difficulty and master the art of restaurant management through escalating challenge levels.

✨ Sprinkles & Card Upgrades – Customize your deck with Sprinkles, a unique system to enhance, modify, and personalize your cards for ultimate synergy.

🏠 Three Distinct Restaurants – Choose between American Diner, Asian Cuisine, and Turkish Doner, each offering a unique playstyle with exclusive card pools and mechanics.

🔥 An Ever-Changing Service – No two runs are the same! Each shift presents different customers, unexpected events, and new opportunities to build your deck and restaurant.

🚀 High-Stakes Strategy, Fast-Paced Fun – Plan ahead, improvise on the fly, and keep up with the dinner rush. Every decision matters in the fast-paced world of Dining Deck!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-6700 CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660Ti
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: This is for the DEMO version only and is only to accept the initial page requirements. Will be updated with specifics when the demo is released.
